intro.h2: Custom showers, laid out and built from the subfloor up
paragraphs: Janke Custom Tile builds custom tile showers in Bay City, MI and across Saginaw and Midland, and has worked in tile for more than 20 years. The work starts below what you see: prepped subfloors for curbless shower pans, waterproofing, then porcelain, ceramic, marble or natural stone set in the pattern you choose.

Kevin is the name reviewers mention. Homeowners describe him calling back right away, measuring and quoting at the house, and even coming on a customer's day off so she could show him the backsplash pattern she wanted. He has restored a hearth with antique salvaged fireplace tiles and replaced 1,700 square feet of floor someone else installed incorrectly.

services.h2: Custom tile showers in Bay City, MI, and the rest of the house

items.name: Custom and curbless showers
items.blurb: Showers built around you: 12 by 24 polished porcelain set vertically in a brick pattern, hexagon marble mosaic floors and bench tops, pebble niches and linear drains. Subfloors are prepped for curbless shower pans so there is no step to trip on. New showers are the most reviewed job.

image.alt: White marble-look porcelain shower with a sliding glass door and recessed niche

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Complete bathroom remodeling, from the shower to the floor. Recent work includes accessible showers with grab bars and dark mosaic floors, and baths finished in large-format marble-look tile. Janke Custom Tile shared a run of completed bathroom remodels in September 2026.

image.alt: Tiled walk-in shower with wood-look wall tile, dark mosaic floor and a grab bar

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Porcelain, ceramic and stone floors, including 24 by 24 checkered porcelain set on the diagonal and polished marble-look tile. In 2022 Janke removed 1,700 square feet of wood-look tile that had been installed incorrectly and replaced it with dark cherry porcelain plank tile.

image.alt: Polished marble-look porcelain floor tile reflecting window light in a large room

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplashes laid out in the pattern you want. Kevin came on one customer's day off so she could show him the exact pattern, and the finished wall pairs large tile with a glass and stone mosaic band behind the sink and range.

image.alt: Kitchen backsplash of large brown tile with a glass and stone mosaic accent band above a light quartz countertop

items.name: Fireplace hearths and restoration
items.blurb: Tile is not only for kitchens and baths. Kevin restored one family's hearth using antique salvaged fireplace tiles, and the homeowner praised his attention to detail. Bring the old pieces you want to keep and ask what can be done.

image.alt: Fireplace hearth restored with antique salvaged tiles in front of an ornate cast iron fireplace cover

process.h2: How a tile project works with Janke

steps.title: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: Call or message (989) 475-5452. Kevin comes to the house to take measurements and give you a quote.

steps.title: Design and layout
steps.text: Pick the tile and pattern. Janke offers custom design and layout, and Kevin will work around your schedule to see the pattern you want.

steps.title: Prep and waterproof
steps.text: Old tile comes out, subfloors are prepped, including for curbless shower pans, and showers are waterproofed before tile goes on.

steps.title: Set, grout and finish
steps.text: Tile is set in your chosen pattern and finished with grout and trim, then you look over the finished work together.

service_area.h2: Tile work in Bay City, Saginaw and Midland
service_area.text: Janke Custom Tile is based at 3390 Dobson Dr in Bay City, Michigan, and has served Bay City, Saginaw and Midland for more than 20 years. It takes on residential and commercial tile work across the three cities. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your home or business is in range, call (989) 475-5452 and ask about a free estimate.

items.a: Yes. Janke Custom Tile invites people to call for a free estimate. Customers say Kevin comes to the house to take measurements and give a quote, and he has scheduled work around a customer's day off. Call or message (989) 475-5452 to set it up.

items.q: Can you build a curbless shower?
items.a: Yes. Janke Custom Tile has shared photos of subfloors prepped for upcoming curbless shower pans. A curbless shower has no step at the entry, which many people want for easier access. Ask about it at your estimate so the floor can be planned for it.

items.q: What kinds of tile do you install?
items.a: Ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tile, including marble. Projects include 12 by 24 polished porcelain walls, hexagon marble mosaic shower floors, 24 by 24 checkered porcelain floors and 8 by 36 porcelain plank flooring. Janke also offers custom design and layout.

items.q: Can you fix a tile job that was done wrong?
items.a: Yes. In 2022 Janke Custom Tile removed 1,700 square feet of six-month-old wood-look tile that had been installed incorrectly and replaced it with dark cherry porcelain plank tile. Call with photos of the problem and Kevin can tell you what it needs.

A September 2024 Janke Custom Tile post describes coverage for installation issues related to their workmanship, such as loose tiles or grout cracking, and mentions Kerdi waterproofing. Ask for the full written terms at your estimate so you know exactly what is covered and for how long.

final_cta.text: Call Janke Custom Tile for a free estimate in Bay City, Saginaw or Midland.
